subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): skip IMDS during credential auto-detection (#64891)

question: Should this PR merge with source-level AWS SDK proof plus the contributor's no-signal live output, or should maintainers require exact-head live proof for both no-signal sandbox suppression and explicit Bedrock default-chain credentials first?
rationale: The patch appears correct, but it changes auth-provider fallback behavior for AWS SDK credential discovery, and source/unit proof cannot fully prove EC2/ECS/profile/SSO upgrade behavior.

options.title: Require live credential-mode proof
options.body: Ask for or run one exact-head no-signal sandbox trace plus one explicit Bedrock AWS default-chain run before merge.

options.title: Accept source-backed compatibility risk
options.body: Merge after green exact-head CI if maintainers accept the dependency source contract and focused tests as enough for this bug fix.

recommendation.title: Require live credential-mode proof
recommendation.body: Ask for or run one exact-head no-signal sandbox trace plus one explicit Bedrock AWS default-chain run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Most closely connected to the provider-plugin memory adapter boundary and prior Bedrock credential-gate merge history.
